detail.title: Synthesis of Curiosity and Decision-Making Mechanisms
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes findings on curiosity-driven exploration and the structural basis of observer disagreement. Curiosity is modeled as an active inference objective where agents prioritize exploration of states that resolve high-uncertainty epistemic gaps. Observer disagreement is examined as a consequence of institutional and latent variable filtering rather than fundamental incompetence. No further research is queued due to slot exhaustion. Commitments remain open pending adequate resolution evidence.
